events.verdict: Johnson (ATL) places a hand against Grant's (POR) body as he comes to a stop and Grant's momentum carries him away from the play.
Williams III (POR) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.

Replay review of the foul called on Camara (POR) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. After Young (ATL) legally comes to a stop and enters his upward shooting motion, Camara (POR) continues forwards into him and initiates illegal contact that affects his jump shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) reaches across Sharpe's (POR) arm in an attempt to get to the ball, initiating contact that affects his shot attempt.
Henderson (POR) maintains a legal guarding position during Daniels' (ATL) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Grant (POR) blocks Krejci's (ATL) shot attempt and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Krejc? (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Sharpe (POR) on the perimeter.
Camara (POR) quickly resets and establishes screening position in Krejci's (ATL) path and marginal contact occurs to his side as he moves over the pick.
Okongwu (ATL) jumps vertically and absorbs the ensuing contact with Sharpe (POR) during his driving shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) makes contact with Sharpe's (POR) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Camara (POR) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Young (ATL) on the perimeter.
Young (ATL) commits a take foul on Sharpe (POR). Young is ahead of Sharpe at the time of the foul and therefore, the play does not meet the criteria for a clear-path foul.
